4: class Battle::AI
5:   MOVE_FAIL_SCORE    = 20
6:   MOVE_USELESS_SCORE = 60   # Move predicted to do nothing or just be detrimental
7:   MOVE_BASE_SCORE    = 100
8: 
9:   # Returns a value between 0.0 and 1.0. All move scores are lowered by this
10:   # value multiplied by the highest-scoring move's score.
11:   def move_score_threshold
12:     return 0.6 + (0.35 * (([@trainer.skill, 100].min / 100.0)**0.5))   # 0.635 to 0.95
13:   end
14: 
15:   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
16: 
17:   # Get scores for the user's moves.
18:   # NOTE: For any move with a target type that can target a foe (or which
19:   #       includes a foe(s) if it has multiple targets), the score calculated
20:   #       for a target ally will be inverted. The MoveHandlers for those moves
21:   #       should therefore treat an ally as a foe when calculating a score
22:   #       against it.
23:   def pbGetMoveScores
24:     choices = []
25:     @user.battler.eachMoveWithIndex do |orig_move, idxMove|
26:       # Unchoosable moves aren't considered
27:       if !@battle.pbCanChooseMove?(@user.index, idxMove, false)
28:         if orig_move.pp == 0 && orig_move.total_pp > 0
29:           PBDebug.log_ai("#{@user.name} cannot use #{orig_move.name} (no PP left)")
30:         else
31:           PBDebug.log_ai("#{@user.name} cannot choose to use #{orig_move.name}")
32:         end
33:         next
34:       end
35:       # Set up move in class variables
36:       set_up_move_check(orig_move)
37:       # Predict whether the move will fail (generally)
38:       if @trainer.has_skill_flag?("PredictMoveFailure") && pbPredictMoveFailure
39:         PBDebug.log_ai("#{@user.name} is considering using #{orig_move.name}...")
40:         PBDebug.log_score_change(MOVE_FAIL_SCORE - MOVE_BASE_SCORE, "move will fail")
41:         add_move_to_choices(choices, idxMove, MOVE_FAIL_SCORE)
42:         next
43:       end
44:       # Get the move's target type
45:       target_data = @move.pbTarget(@user.battler)
46:       if @move.function_code == "CurseTargetOrLowerUserSpd1RaiseUserAtkDef1" &&
47:          @move.rough_type == :GHOST && @user.has_active_ability?([:LIBERO, :PROTEAN])
48:         target_data = GameData::Target.get((Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 8) ? :RandomNearFoe : :NearFoe)
49:       end
50:       case target_data.num_targets
51:       when 0   # No targets, affects the user or a side or the whole field
52:         # Includes: BothSides, FoeSide, None, User, UserSide
53:         PBDebug.log_ai("#{@user.name} is considering using #{orig_move.name}...")
54:         score = MOVE_BASE_SCORE
55:         PBDebug.logonerr { score = pbGetMoveScore }
56:         add_move_to_choices(choices, idxMove, score)
57:       when 1   # One target to be chosen by the trainer
58:         # Includes: Foe, NearAlly, NearFoe, NearOther, Other, RandomNearFoe, UserOrNearAlly
59:         redirected_target = get_redirected_target(target_data)
60:         num_targets = 0
61:         @battle.allBattlers.each do |b|
62:           next if redirected_target && b.index != redirected_target
63:           next if !@battle.pbMoveCanTarget?(@user.battler.index, b.index, target_data)
64:           next if target_data.targets_foe && !@user.battler.opposes?(b)
65:           PBDebug.log_ai("#{@user.name} is considering using #{orig_move.name} against #{b.name} (#{b.index})...")
66:           score = MOVE_BASE_SCORE
67:           PBDebug.logonerr { score = pbGetMoveScore([b]) }
68:           add_move_to_choices(choices, idxMove, score, b.index)
69:           num_targets += 1
70:         end
71:         PBDebug.log("     no valid targets") if num_targets == 0
72:       else   # Multiple targets at once
73:         # Includes: AllAllies, AllBattlers, AllFoes, AllNearFoes, AllNearOthers, UserAndAllies
74:         targets = []
75:         @battle.allBattlers.each do |b|
76:           next if !@battle.pbMoveCanTarget?(@user.battler.index, b.index, target_data)
77:           targets.push(b)
78:         end
79:         PBDebug.log_ai("#{@user.name} is considering using #{orig_move.name}...")
80:         score = MOVE_BASE_SCORE
81:         PBDebug.logonerr { score = pbGetMoveScore(targets) }
82:         add_move_to_choices(choices, idxMove, score)
83:       end
84:     end
85:     @battle.moldBreaker = false
86:     return choices
87:   end

89:   # If the target of a move can be changed by an external effect, this method
90:   # returns the battler index of the new target.
91:   def get_redirected_target(target_data)
92:     return nil if @move.move.cannotRedirect?
93:     return nil if !target_data.can_target_one_foe? || target_data.num_targets != 1
94:     return nil if @user.has_active_ability?([:PROPELLERTAIL, :STALWART])
95:     priority = @battle.pbPriority(true)
96:     near_only = !target_data.can_choose_distant_target?
97:     # Spotlight, Follow Me/Rage Powder
98:     new_target = -1
99:     strength = 100   # Lower strength takes priority
100:     priority.each do |b|
101:       next if b.fainted? || b.effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0
102:       next if !b.opposes?(@user.battler)
103:       next if near_only && !b.near?(@user.battler)
104:       if b.effects[PBEffects::Spotlight] > 0 && b.effects[PBEffects::Spotlight] - 50 < strength
105:         new_target = b.index
106:         strength = b.effects[PBEffects::Spotlight] - 50   # Spotlight takes priority
107:       elsif (b.effects[PBEffects::RagePowder] && @user.battler.affectedByPowder?) ||
108:             (b.effects[PBEffects::FollowMe] > 0 && b.effects[PBEffects::FollowMe] < strength)
109:         new_target = b.index
110:         strength = b.effects[PBEffects::FollowMe]
111:       end
112:     end
113:     return new_target if new_target >= 0
114:     calc_type = @move.rough_type
115:     priority.each do |b|
116:       next if b.index == @user.index
117:       next if near_only && !b.near?(@user.battler)
118:       case calc_type
119:       when :ELECTRIC
120:         new_target = b.index if b.hasActiveAbility?(:LIGHTNINGROD)
121:       when :WATER
122:         new_target = b.index if b.hasActiveAbility?(:STORMDRAIN)
123:       end
124:       break if new_target >= 0
125:     end
126:     return (new_target >= 0) ? new_target : nil
127:   end

129:   def add_move_to_choices(choices, idxMove, score, idxTarget = -1)
130:     choices.push([idxMove, score, idxTarget])
131:     # If the user is a wild Pokémon, doubly prefer one of its moves (the choice
132:     # is random but consistent and does not correlate to any other property of
133:     # the user)
134:     if @user.wild? && @user.pokemon.personalID % @user.battler.moves.length == idxMove
135:       choices.push([idxMove, score, idxTarget])
136:     end
137:   end

141:   # Set some extra class variables for the move being assessed.
142:   def set_up_move_check(move)
143:     case move.function_code
144:     when "UseLastMoveUsed"
145:       if @battle.lastMoveUsed &&
146:          GameData::Move.exists?(@battle.lastMoveUsed) &&
147:          !move.moveBlacklist.include?(GameData::Move.get(@battle.lastMoveUsed).function_code)
148:         move = Battle::Move.from_pokemon_move(@battle, Pokemon::Move.new(@battle.lastMoveUsed))
149:       end
150:     when "UseMoveDependingOnEnvironment"
151:       move.pbOnStartUse(@user.battler, [])   # Determine which move is used instead
152:       move = Battle::Move.from_pokemon_move(@battle, Pokemon::Move.new(move.npMove))
153:     end
154:     @battle.moldBreaker = @user.has_mold_breaker?
155:     @move.set_up(move)
156:   end
157: 
158:   # Set some extra class variables for the target being assessed.
159:   def set_up_move_check_target(target)
160:     @target = (target) ? @battlers[target.index] : nil
161:     @target&.refresh_battler
162:     if @target && @move.function_code == "UseLastMoveUsedByTarget"
163:       if @target.battler.lastRegularMoveUsed &&
164:          GameData::Move.exists?(@target.battler.lastRegularMoveUsed) &&
165:          GameData::Move.get(@target.battler.lastRegularMoveUsed).has_flag?("CanMirrorMove")
166:         @battle.moldBreaker = @user.has_mold_breaker?
167:         mov = Battle::Move.from_pokemon_move(@battle, Pokemon::Move.new(@target.battler.lastRegularMoveUsed))
168:         @move.set_up(mov)
169:       end
170:     end
171:   end

175:   # Returns whether the move will definitely fail (assuming no battle conditions
176:   # change between now and using the move).
177:   def pbPredictMoveFailure
178:     # User is asleep and will not wake up
179:     return true if @user.battler.asleep? && @user.statusCount > 1 && !@move.move.usableWhenAsleep?
180:     # User is awake and can't use moves that are only usable when asleep
181:     return true if !@user.battler.asleep? && @move.move.usableWhenAsleep?
182:     # NOTE: Truanting is not considered, because if it is, a Pokémon with Truant
183:     #       will want to switch due to terrible moves every other round (because
184:     #       all of its moves will fail), and this is disruptive and shouldn't be
185:     #       how such Pokémon behave.
186:     # Primal weather
187:     return true if @battle.pbWeather == :HeavyRain && @move.rough_type == :FIRE
188:     return true if @battle.pbWeather == :HarshSun && @move.rough_type == :WATER
189:     # Move effect-specific checks
190:     return true if Battle::AI::Handlers.move_will_fail?(@move.function_code, @move, @user, self, @battle)
191:     return false
192:   end
193: 
194:   # Returns whether the move will definitely fail against the target (assuming
195:   # no battle conditions change between now and using the move).
196:   def pbPredictMoveFailureAgainstTarget
197:     # Move effect-specific checks
198:     return true if Battle::AI::Handlers.move_will_fail_against_target?(@move.function_code, @move, @user, @target, self, @battle)
199:     # Immunity to priority moves because of Psychic Terrain
200:     return true if @battle.field.terrain == :Psychic && @target.battler.affectedByTerrain? &&
201:                    @target.opposes?(@user) && @move.rough_priority(@user) > 0
202:     # Immunity because of ability
203:     return true if @move.move.pbImmunityByAbility(@user.battler, @target.battler, false)
204:     # Immunity because of Dazzling/Queenly Majesty
205:     if @move.rough_priority(@user) > 0 && @target.opposes?(@user)
206:       each_same_side_battler(@target.side) do |b, i|
207:         return true if b.has_active_ability?([:DAZZLING, :QUEENLYMAJESTY])
208:       end
209:     end
210:     # Type immunity
211:     calc_type = @move.rough_type
212:     typeMod = @move.move.pbCalcTypeMod(calc_type, @user.battler, @target.battler)
213:     return true if @move.move.pbDamagingMove? && Effectiveness.ineffective?(typeMod)
214:     # Dark-type immunity to moves made faster by Prankster
215:     return true if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7 && @move.statusMove? &&
216:                    @user.has_active_ability?(:PRANKSTER) && @target.has_type?(:DARK) && @target.opposes?(@user)
217:     # Airborne-based immunity to Ground moves
218:     return true if @move.damagingMove? && calc_type == :GROUND &&
219:                    @target.battler.airborne? && !@move.move.hitsFlyingTargets?
220:     # Immunity to powder-based moves
221:     return true if @move.move.powderMove? && !@target.battler.affectedByPowder?
222:     # Substitute
223:     return true if @target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0 && @move.statusMove? &&
224:                    !@move.move.ignoresSubstitute?(@user.battler) && @user.index != @target.index
225:     return false
226:   end

230:   # Get a score for the given move being used against the given target.
231:   # Assumes def set_up_move_check has previously been called.
232:   def pbGetMoveScore(targets = nil)
233:     # Get the base score for the move
234:     score = MOVE_BASE_SCORE
235:     # Scores for each target in turn
236:     if targets
237:       # Reset the base score for the move (each target will add its own score)
238:       score = 0
239:       affected_targets = 0
240:       # Get a score for the move against each target in turn
241:       orig_move = @move.move   # In case move is Mirror Move and changes depending on the target
242:       targets.each do |target|
243:         set_up_move_check(orig_move)
244:         set_up_move_check_target(target)
245:         t_score = pbGetMoveScoreAgainstTarget
246:         next if t_score < 0
247:         score += t_score
248:         affected_targets += 1
249:       end
250:       # Set the default score if no targets were affected
251:       if affected_targets == 0
252:         score = (@trainer.has_skill_flag?("PredictMoveFailure")) ? MOVE_USELESS_SCORE : MOVE_BASE_SCORE
253:       end
254:       # Score based on how many targets were affected
255:       if affected_targets == 0 && @trainer.has_skill_flag?("PredictMoveFailure")
256:         if !@move.move.worksWithNoTargets?
257:           PBDebug.log_score_change(MOVE_FAIL_SCORE - MOVE_BASE_SCORE, "move will fail")
258:           return MOVE_FAIL_SCORE
259:         end
260:       else
261:         score /= affected_targets if affected_targets > 1   # Average the score against multiple targets
262:         # Bonus for affecting multiple targets
263:         if @trainer.has_skill_flag?("PreferMultiTargetMoves") && affected_targets > 1
264:           old_score = score
265:           score += (affected_targets - 1) * 10
266:           PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "affects multiple battlers")
267:         end
268:       end
269:     end
270:     # If we're here, the move either has no targets or at least one target will
271:     # be affected (or the move is usable even if no targets are affected, e.g.
272:     # Self-Destruct)
273:     if @trainer.has_skill_flag?("ScoreMoves")
274:       # Modify the score according to the move's effect
275:       old_score = score
276:       score = Battle::AI::Handlers.apply_move_effect_score(@move.function_code,
277:          score, @move, @user, self, @battle)
278:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "function code modifier (generic)")
279:       # Modify the score according to various other effects
280:       score = Battle::AI::Handlers.apply_general_move_score_modifiers(
281:         score, @move, @user, self, @battle)
282:     end
283:     score = score.to_i
284:     score = 0 if score < 0
285:     return score
286:   end

288:   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
289: 
290:   # Returns the score of @move being used against @target. A return value of -1
291:   # means the move will fail or do nothing against the target.
292:   # Assumes def set_up_move_check and def set_up_move_check_target have
293:   # previously been called.
294:   def pbGetMoveScoreAgainstTarget
295:     # Predict whether the move will fail against the target
296:     if @trainer.has_skill_flag?("PredictMoveFailure") && pbPredictMoveFailureAgainstTarget
297:       PBDebug.log("     move will not affect #{@target.name}")
298:       return -1
299:     end
300:     # Score the move
301:     score = MOVE_BASE_SCORE
302:     if @trainer.has_skill_flag?("ScoreMoves")
303:       # Modify the score according to the move's effect against the target
304:       old_score = score
305:       score = Battle::AI::Handlers.apply_move_effect_against_target_score(@move.function_code,
306:          MOVE_BASE_SCORE, @move, @user, @target, self, @battle)
307:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "function code modifier (against target)")
308:       # Modify the score according to various other effects against the target
309:       score = Battle::AI::Handlers.apply_general_move_against_target_score_modifiers(
310:         score, @move, @user, @target, self, @battle)
311:     end
312:     # Add the score against the target to the overall score
313:     target_data = @move.pbTarget(@user.battler)
314:     if target_data.targets_foe && !@target.opposes?(@user) && @target.index != @user.index
315:       if score == MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
316:         PBDebug.log("     move is useless against #{@target.name}")
317:         return -1
318:       end
319:       old_score = score
320:       score = ((1.85 * MOVE_BASE_SCORE) - score).to_i
321:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "score inverted (move targets ally but can target foe)")
322:     end
323:     return score
324:   end

328:   # Make the final choice of which move to use depending on the calculated
329:   # scores for each move. Moves with higher scores are more likely to be chosen.
330:   def pbChooseMove(choices)
331:     user_battler = @user.battler
332:     # If no moves can be chosen, auto-choose a move or Struggle
333:     if choices.length == 0
334:       @battle.pbAutoChooseMove(user_battler.index)
335:       PBDebug.log_ai("#{@user.name} will auto-use a move or Struggle")
336:       return
337:     end
338:     # Figure out useful information about the choices
339:     max_score = 0
340:     choices.each { |c| max_score = c[1] if max_score < c[1] }
341:     # Decide whether all choices are bad, and if so, try switching instead
342:     if @trainer.high_skill? && @user.can_switch_lax?
343:       badMoves = false
344:       if max_score <= MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
345:         badMoves = user.can_attack?
346:         badMoves = true if !badMoves && pbAIRandom(100) < 25
347:       elsif max_score < MOVE_BASE_SCORE * move_score_threshold && user_battler.turnCount > 2
348:         badMoves = true if pbAIRandom(100) < 80
349:       end
350:       if badMoves
351:         PBDebug.log_ai("#{@user.name} wants to switch due to terrible moves")
352:         if pbChooseToSwitchOut(true)
353:           @battle.pbUnregisterMegaEvolution(@user.index)
354:           return
355:         end
356:         PBDebug.log_ai("#{@user.name} won't switch after all")
357:       end
358:     end
359:     # Calculate a minimum score threshold and reduce all move scores by it
360:     threshold = (max_score * move_score_threshold.to_f).floor
361:     choices.each { |c| c[3] = [c[1] - threshold, 0].max }
362:     total_score = choices.sum { |c| c[3] }
363:     # Log the available choices
364:     if $INTERNAL
365:       PBDebug.log_ai("Move choices for #{@user.name}:")
366:       choices.each_with_index do |c, i|
367:         chance = sprintf("%5.1f", (c[3] > 0) ? 100.0 * c[3] / total_score : 0)
368:         log_msg = "   * #{chance}% to use #{user_battler.moves[c[0]].name}"
369:         log_msg += " (target #{c[2]})" if c[2] >= 0
370:         log_msg += ": score #{c[1]}"
371:         PBDebug.log(log_msg)
372:       end
373:     end
374:     # Pick a move randomly from choices weighted by their scores
375:     randNum = pbAIRandom(total_score)
376:     choices.each do |c|
377:       randNum -= c[3]
378:       next if randNum >= 0
379:       @battle.pbRegisterMove(user_battler.index, c[0], false)
380:       @battle.pbRegisterTarget(user_battler.index, c[2]) if c[2] >= 0
381:       break
382:     end
383:     # Log the result
384:     if @battle.choices[user_battler.index][2]
385:       move_name = @battle.choices[user_battler.index][2].name
386:       if @battle.choices[user_battler.index][3] >= 0
387:         PBDebug.log("   => will use #{move_name} (target #{@battle.choices[user_battler.index][3]})")
388:       else
389:         PBDebug.log("   => will use #{move_name}")
390:       end
391:     end
392:   end
393: end
